FOREST HAVEN KIT – An Eco-Friendly Gift Set | D1350

The FOREST HAVEN KIT – An Eco-Friendly Gift Set | D1350 is a thoughtfully curated sustainable gift hamper designed for brands, corporates, and eco-conscious individuals seeking premium, responsible gifting options. This eco-friendly gift set blends functionality, natural materials, and sustainability—making it a top choice among companies looking for eco corporate gifts and sustainable gifting solutions.

Made from materials like bamboo, cork, and plantable seed paper, the Forest Haven Kit stands out as a high-value, environmentally responsible gifting option. Each item is crafted to promote reusability, minimal waste, and a greener lifestyle. Whether you’re planning employee onboarding gifts, festive corporate gifts, or eco-friendly client hampers, this sustainable gift box offers the perfect mix of aesthetic appeal and environmental responsibility.

Why Choose the FOREST HAVEN KIT?

In today’s world, brands are shifting toward eco-friendly gifts that reflect responsibility and sustainability. This eco-friendly gift set includes daily-use essentials made from renewable materials. Its premium design and eco-conscious approach make it ideal for corporate events, employee joining kits, brand promotions, and festival gifting. The Forest Haven Kit is not only practical but also contributes positively to the environment with plantable components that grow into herbs or plants.

Key Features of the Forest Haven Kit – Eco-Friendly Corporate Gift Set

  • Forest Wall Stand – A beautifully crafted wooden stand for desks, promoting natural aesthetics.
  • Bamboo Pen – Lightweight, reusable, and made from 100% natural bamboo.
  • Bamboo Bottle (450ml) – Eco-friendly, durable, stylish, and perfect for daily hydration.
  • Plantable Calendar (Wood) – Each month contains seed paper that can be planted after use.
  • Plantable Pen & Pencil (2+2) – Grow herbs or plants after writing, minimizing waste.
  • Cork Sticky Notes – Made from natural cork, reusable and biodegradable.
  • 4 Cork Coasters with Holder – Elegant, heat-resistant, and crafted from sustainable cork.
  • Packed in Eco Box (12”x8”x3”) – Plastic-free packaging designed for gifting and reuse.

Perfect for Corporate Eco-Friendly Gifting

The FOREST HAVEN KIT – An Eco-Friendly Gift Set | D1350 is widely used by companies for sustainable corporate gifting. It aligns perfectly with ESG goals and reflects a brand’s commitment to environmental responsibility. This eco-friendly gift set not only elevates the gifting experience but also leaves a lasting impression on recipients by offering meaningful, purposeful, and reusable items.

With growing demand for eco gifts, bamboo gift sets, and plantable gift items, this kit helps your brand stand out while reducing carbon footprint. Its premium finish, well-balanced curation, and biodegradable materials make it a popular choice for HR teams, marketing departments, and event planners seeking sustainable alternatives.

Who Should Choose This Eco-Friendly Gift Set?

  • Companies seeking eco corporate gift hampers
  • Brands with sustainability and ESG commitments
  • Startups and workplaces offering green onboarding kits
  • Organizations promoting zero-waste culture
  • Festive gifting with an eco-conscious twist

Overall, the Forest Haven Kit is not just a gift set—it’s a responsible choice that promotes environmental awareness and encourages sustainable living. If your brand values sustainability, this eco-friendly corporate gift set is the ideal way to express it.
